title: Waverly Place 16-Inch Double Glass Shelf With Gallery Rail (Wall Mount) -, Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear countertop clutter and keep daily essentials within reach with a double-tier glass shelf built for organized bathroom storage.

  • More storage in one footprint — double shelf design is an ideal use of vertical wall space.
  • Items stay put — gallery rail is designed to keep toiletries and décor in place.
  • Strength you can count on — 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for safety and durability.
  • Enduring hardware — solid brass construction with concealed screw mounting for a clean look.
  • Easy to coordinate — part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place pieces in transitional bathroom hardware.

Specs

  • Glass dimensions (each shelf): 16 x 5 Inches
  • Overall dimensions: 16 in L x 5 in W x 8 in H
  • Projection: 5 in
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in)
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
  • Assembly required: False
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size: #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Material: Brass hardware
